name: Jumbo Search API
description: Searches Jumbo products using the Webfuse Automation API. Registers MCP tools for search_product and scan_page.

tools.name: jumbo_search
tools.description: Search for a product on Jumbo. Navigates to the Jumbo search page, waits for results to load, scans the page using the Automation API, and returns a list of products with name, price, image, pack size, and add-to-cart button selector.

tools.name: jumbo_scan_page
tools.description: Scan the current Jumbo page for products using the Automation API. Returns all products found on the current page with their details and add-to-cart button selectors.
